title: Boku no Hero Academia 7th Season
content:
My Hero Academia peaked with season six, or so I thought.

It is without a doubt that the series has faced its fair share of “mid” allegations from fans and haters alike, sure, last season (season 6) has made a lot of those people tremble and rethink that harsh classification, but surely, it was an outlier season, right?

The seventh season begs to differ. It carried on that Olympic torch like a champ and kept up the pace and tension thoroughly.

One thing for sure, aside from the consistent action and narrative highs this season maintained, there was a huge focus on characters and their development more thanever before. We would get arcs that lay focus on a few key characters before, but this one looked at Class A, and so fan favorite villains and delivered really good moments and new looks into some of the more forgotten characters, making them more than background crowd and more like motivated key players in this big conflict.

The lack of new lore, as I noticed, really went under covered thanks to the many other good things besides characters and motivations. The fights, which go without saying were really good, although I thought they could have had slightly better, more polished animation to boot. Not to say this season was not visually pleasing, more than that, but we’ve had better animated fights and scenes on earlier seasons with lower stakes.

Overall: 8.9/10.
